newsitem.title: USA: United Technologies unit forms new group.
newsitem.headline: United Technologies unit forms new group.

text.p: United Technologies Corp said Wednesday its UT Automotive division has formed a new Advanced Technology organization to foster research programs.

The company said the group unites 75 technical experts and engineers from North America, Europe and Asia. The group will devise strategies to help UT Automotive customers reduce costs and development time, UT Automotive said.
United Technologies is a Hartford, Connecticut-based provider of high-tech products and services to a variety of industries.
Its shares were off 1/8 Wednesday at 74-3/4.
